messages:
Iris: dropping a short thread about axis label localization + unit precision. mock in figma: https://figma.redwood/axis-localize. main asks: localized number formats, trailing unit precision toggle, and an 'outlier peek' overlay so spikes don't collapse trends.
Dev: neat. for localization, prefer using ICU number formatting so it respects both grouping and decimal separators per locale. show examples inline: en-US '1,234.56', de-DE '1.234,56'.
Noah: precision toggle: propose 'Compact' (1 decimal) vs 'Exact' (full integer). UI: small pill in legend that remembers per-user preference. Also keyboard shortcut option (press 'u' to toggle units).
Zoe: outlier peek: instead of clipping or rescaling, we can render a tiny vertical glimpse box to the right showing the extreme value in context (mini-card) with a callout line to the main chart. tooltip should say 'peek: 98,432 (outlier)'.
Iris: love the peek idea. accessibility: ensure the peek gets focus and is announced, and that it's reachable via keyboard nav. can we provide an aria-live region announcing when a peek is present?
A11yRobot: recommendation: use aria-live polite for non-disruptive updates, but also provide a focusable control 'Show outlier' that sets focus to the expanded peek and has aria-describedby with full value + timestamp. Ensure contrast for callout >= 4.5:1.
Dev: implementation detail: backend can mark points with metadata: {"overflow":"peek","raw":98432,"ts":1680000000}. front-end reads flag and decides whether to draw peek instead of scaling. We only need a small list of peek points per series.
Noah: smoothing UX: default presets: 'Raw', 'Low (0.2)', 'Med (0.5)', 'High (0.8)'. For sparklines default to Raw. For longer spans (>=7d) default to Med. show a small preview sparkline next to each preset.
Zoe: copy nit: call the units toggle 'Display' with options 'Compact / Exact' instead of symbols. For internal dashboards we can show 'K/M'. Also add a tooltip: 'Compact rounds for readability; Exact shows full values.'
Iris: axis ticks: propose localized tick labels (use ICU) and add an option 'Force SI' which always uses K/M/B for quick scanning. When forced, hover shows full localized number.
Dev: legend behavior when many series: compact list with typeahead filter + 'pin primary' feature. Pin persists in user settings. If pinned, primary series gets bolder stroke and shows full label even in collapse mode.
Noah: printing/export: ensure exported PNG/PDF uses Exact values and expands any peek into full-scale view. Also expose a 'Print-friendly' toggle that increases font sizes and simplifies gridlines.
Zoe: performance: stream downsampled series and separate peek list: payload = downsampled_points + peek_points. client renders downsampled and overlays peek markers, fetching full-point-on-demand. This keeps initial payload small.
A11yRobot: final checklist: role=img + aria-label summary; focusable peek controls; aria-live for new peeks; ensure all toggles reachable by keyboard; visible focus rings.
Iris: action items: Dev will add ICU formatting + unit toggle component mock; Noah will wire smoothing presets and preview mini-sparklines; Zoe will prototype outlier peek card + keyboard flows. A11yRobot will run checks once prototype up. Target: internal review next Tue. :calendar:
